verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm. Issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials to agents is a developer-platform capability, which makes this story a category error for a legal-services provider. Its client tools (GDHQ, Contract Generator, Catalyze) are portals with no evidence of an API surface, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec, so the exception for actually shipping the capability does not apply.
